standard_prerequisites.name: Right exactness of tensor product
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Algebra, section on tensor products
standard_prerequisites.use: Underlies the step producing M^{\oplus m} \to M^{\oplus n} \to M \otimes_\Lambda Q \to 0 from the presentation of Q.

core_obligations: Choose a presentation \Lambda^{\oplus m} \to \Lambda^{\oplus n} \to Q \to 0 and tensor with M to obtain the exact sequence M^{\oplus m} \to M^{\oplus n} \to M \otimes_\Lambda Q \to 0 (proof lines 8446-8448).

Apply the exactness of the underline functor on exact sequences of constant modules (lemma-constant-exact) to get the exact sequence of sections \underline{M}(U)^{\oplus m} \to \underline{M}(U)^{\oplus n} \to \underline{M \otimes Q}(U) \to 0 (proof lines 8449-8454).

Conclude \underline{M \otimes_\Lambda Q}(U) = \underline{M}(U) \otimes_\Lambda Q, using that taking sections over U commutes with finite direct sums but not arbitrary direct sums (proof lines 8455-8456).
proof_roadmap: Pick a finite presentation of Q and tensor with M.
Push the exact sequence through the underline construction via lemma-constant-exact.
Read off the equality of sections, flagging where finiteness of the direct sums is used.
difficulty_reason: The proof runs a presentation argument: choose a finite presentation \Lambda^{\oplus m} \to \Lambda^{\oplus n} \to Q \to 0, tensor with M to get an exact sequence, apply the exactness of the underline construction on exact sequences of constant modules (lemma-constant-exact, proved earlier in this chapter), and read off the equality of section functors; the finiteness of the presentation is exactly what lets the last step land in finite direct sums, to which taking sections over U commutes. The bookkeeping of which direct sums stay finite is the substance.
